title: RESYNC: Residual Latent-State Synchronization for Deadline-Bound Streaming Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.16523v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Predicting every observation in a high-rate stream requires a model to finish before the next arrival. A large model may offer better predictions but miss that deadline. We propose RESYNC: the large model runs asynchronously, while a fast path updates its latest exact but stale latent state using the observations received since that state was computed and applies its unchanged prediction head. The updater learns from the frozen model's representations without task labels. Across one real and two synthetic streams and five architecture families, RESYNC beats the best compact or distilled alternative with a paired 95% interval above zero in all twelve dataset--architecture pairs with a material teacher advantage at anchor ages of 4--12 observations, and in eleven pairs at older tested ages up to 32. The share of the teacher's gain preserved remains complete on the real stream but is lower and generally declines with anchor age on the syn

translated_title: RESYNC：面向截止期限约束流式推理的残差潜在状态同步
translated_abstract: 预测高速率数据流中的每一个观测值，要求模型必须在下一个数据到达之前完成计算。大模型可能提供更好的预测，但会错过这一截止期限。我们提出 RESYNC：大模型异步运行，同时由一条快速路径利用自该状态计算以来新接收到的观测值，对其最新但已过时的精确潜在状态进行更新，并应用其保持不变的预测头。该更新器无需任务标签，直接从冻结模型学到的表示中进行学习。在一个真实数据流和两个合成数据流以及五种架构家族的实验中，RESYNC 在全部十二个数据集--架构配对中以配对95%置信区间高于零的优势超越了最佳的紧凑模型或蒸馏替代方案，在锚定年龄为 4--12 个观测值时教师优势显著；在测试年龄最高达 32 的较老锚定年龄下，十二个配对中仍有十一个保持优势。在真实数据流上所保留的教师收益份额保持完整，但在合成数据流上较低，且通常随锚定年龄的增加而下降。
tldr: RESYNC 让大模型异步运行，并用快速更新器根据新到达的观测值刷新其潜在状态，从而在满足流式推理截止期限的同时保留大模型的预测优势。
en_tdlr: RESYNC preserves a large model's predictive advantage under deadline-bound streaming inference by running it asynchronously while a fast updater refreshes its latent state with newly arrived observations.
